subject: biology

hotspots.label: Double helix
hotspots.description: The twisted, ladder shape of two DNA strands wound together.
hotspots.positionHint: The whole strand running vertically in the frame.
hotspots.function: Shape that lets the molecule be stored compact and copied exactly.

hotspots.label: Sugar-phosphate backbone
hotspots.description: The two rails of the ladder, made of alternating sugar and phosphate.
hotspots.positionHint: Left rail of the double helix, running top to bottom.
hotspots.function: Forms the strong outer rails of the DNA ladder.

hotspots.label: Base pair (a rung)
hotspots.description: Two base letters snapped together like a rung between the rails.
hotspots.positionHint: The mid-height rung connecting the two rails.
hotspots.function: Holds the two strands together using the A-T and G-C pairing rule.

hotspots.label: Gene segment
hotspots.description: A stretch of the DNA that holds one instruction or gene.
hotspots.positionHint: A short highlighted stretch along the helix.
hotspots.function: A specific run of base letters that codes for an instruction.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white/paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. The helix runs vertical and large in frame. Rails in a muted warm taupe, the base rungs in paired soft hues (A a warm rose, T a soft amber, G a muted green, C a soft blue) but all low saturation - gentle and calm, not a bright infographic. Reserved hotspot dots for emphasis.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR metallic=0. Rails matte ~0.5, base rungs slightly glossier. No emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: an upright DNA double helix from a stretch of ~6-7 base pairs shown clearly twisted. Two smooth sinusoidal strand (the two backbones) winding, with tenor rounded rung pieces connecting them (the paired bases). Provide a 'pairing' layer where two letters snap together with a subtle click, an 'unroll' view where the helix flattens into two complementary strands, and a 'gene' highlight a subset of rungs. All colors muted, no glow. Named nodes: RailA, RailB, BasePair_rung01..., GeneSegment_highlight. Budget 10-16k.
referenceMatch: Matches the warm off-white centered object style of the reference screenshots.
